market_outlook.short_term: Risk-on tone with US futures rising and Brent declining, but fragile. US-China truce provides tailwind while diesel inflation and consumer stress cap upside. Buffett transition may cause brief volatility. Watch Trump-Xi summit as binary catalyst. Expect 2-4% equity volatility into midterms.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex supercycle (OpenAI, CoreWeave, Nvidia) supports 12-18 month tech leadership, but governance/security risks and OpenAI cash burn create correction risk. Energy structural shift (refinery chokepoint, LNG) favors integrated majors. US fiscal trajectory (yields vs. CBO) is the dominant macro risk over 6-12 months. Consumer weakness may force Fed policy pivot.
